_meta.description: Free: NVIDIA LLM writes a scene-per-line script, Storyboard Video renders it to an H.264 MP4 (no video model, zero cost).

inputs.prompt: A 20-second explainer: how a lighthouse guides ships at night
inputs.system_prompt: You are a video scriptwriter. Write exactly 6 scenes for a short video. One scene per line, each a single punchy sentence of at most 14 words, no numbering, no blank lines, no extra commentary.
